m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: The Xibalba Codex? The sky-watchers of old used a certain code when they wrote their codices, to keep their knowledge secret.
The need for secrets has long passed. The Ciphers were kept in one of the Estates in the Cenote... that is where you must go.
Find the Ciphers to the Xibalba Codex and return it to me, and we will decipher the secrets of Xibalba.
I will tell you exactly where to find the Ciphers. I hope they have not been taken by the Hungry Dead!
With the Ciphers, we can now read more of the Xibalba Codex. The ancient scholars wrote much about it...
<ITALICS>The sky now watches Azteca with a Sparking Eye. The eye of the dread Xibalba, the Place of Fear. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>This is the end of the cycle, the time beyond time. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>What can blind the Sparking Eye of the heavens? What can defeat the Place of Fear? What can slay Xibalba? </ITALICS>
At any rate, there is much to read here. Please tell Tezcat what we have discovered!
You found the Ciphers and translated the Xibalba Codex? Is there no deed beyond your reach?
I have long studied the Xibalba Codex, but even after all this time, its mysteries still elude me! It was written in a clever code!
My friend Zaylin Reedwalker may be able to help. She understands codes and ciphers better than Pacal or myself.
Speak to Zaylin here in the Zocalo and see if you might find some way to decode the Xibalba Codex.
Speak to Zaylin Reedwalker here in the Zocalo and see if you can find a means of decoding the Xibalba Codex.
